name: P24 leave Puddlewick after Papa at the lane

steps.note: Walk south toward the lane-out pad at z~27.6

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const w=Field.world();const exits=(w.map&&w.map.exits)||[];const lane=exits.find(e=>e.to==='meadow'||/lane/i.test(e.name||''));window.__LANE=lane;__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',lane?lane.x:16.6,lane?lane.z:27.6);await sleep(400);for(let i=0;i<40;i++){await sleep(100);if(__DQ.state().map.id==='meadow')return 'meadow';}return JSON.stringify({map:__DQ.state().map.id,lane:lane&&{x:lane.x,z:lane.z,w:lane.w,h:lane.h,to:lane.to},player:__DQ.state().player,errors:__DQ.errors.slice(-5)});})()

steps.msg: standing on lane-out reaches the meadow
